messages:
sam_pm: Need a lightweight rollout doc for routing-fallbacks that balances deterministic fallbacks and per-tenant safety. Looking for an agreedlow + feature-flag primitives by EOD.

rui_eng: Proposal: 'progressive safety lattice' - shadow -> micro-canary (0.25%) -> small canary (1%) -> regional ramp (10%) -> broad ramp (25+%). Each step has baked telemetry gates and a cooldown.

marta_sre: Gate rules: p99 delta <= 20% OR absolute error increase <= 0.25% -> trigger soft rollback. Soft rollback = automated reduce slice to 0.05%. Hard rollback = tenant or global kill. Require 10m grace before escalation to avoid noise.

ben_support: Support asks: allow per-tenant opt-out and an enterprise opt-in list (up to 8 customers). Also a ready-made status blurb and an ops contact list for immediate rollback.

devops: Flag model: hierarchical keys. Example YAML (stored as typed config):
```yaml
ff.routing_fallbacks.v2.enabled: true
ff.routing_fallbacks.v2.slice_pct: 1
ff.routing_fallbacks.v2.scope: region
ff.routing_fallbacks.v2.per_tenant: {"tenant-42": {enabled: true, slice_pct: 5}}
ff.routing_fallbacks.v2.emergency_off: false
```
Make sure kill-switch can be scoped tenant/region/global. Audit log every toggle.

rui_eng: Region order proposal (low-impact first): secondary-edge -> us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 -> us-east-1. For EU-sensitive tenants run a parallel per-tenant test in eu-west-1 with KMS gating off for Private.

marta_sre: Telemetry to monitor during each step: p50/p95/p99, error-rate, fallback-invocations, reroute-rate, host-saturation. Add trace sampling: 100% of micro-canary, 10% at 1%, 2% beyond. Store traces encrypted and redact PII.

sam_pm: A/B vs canary: use canary for infra/latency; A/B only for UX metrics. Also ensure cohorts don't overlap to avoid double exposure.

ben_support: Can we add customer-facing opt-in toggles in the portal for the 8 test customers? They want a one-click rollback too.

devops: We'll expose an admin toggle + webhook for support notifications. Portal changes tracked by audit events. ops-bot: creating tickets for automation and portal work.

ops-bot: created RI-13001 (rollout-automation) assigned to rui_eng/devops and RI-13002 (portal-optin) assigned to devops/ben_support. Dry-run target: 2026-04-07T08:00:00Z.

sam_pm: Decisions recorded: 1) Progressive safety lattice (0.25% -> 1% -> 10% -> 25%) 2) Hierarchical flags with per-tenant kill and global emergency_off 3) Telemetry gating + soft rollback -> hard rollback ladder 4) Portal opt-in for up to 8 customers + webhook 5) Trace sampling policy and EU KMS gating for Private.

marta_sre: Action items: implement gate automation + cooldowns. devops: flag wiring + audit + portal. rui_eng: rollout script + dry-run. ben_support: customer comms + contact list. sam_pm: sign-off post dry-run.

sam_pm: If anyone sees missing gaps DM me. Thanks! :rocket:
